decision.rationale: Attempt 003 is operationally invalid because the second provider canary returned empty content. Preserve the run, revoke authorization, and make one explicit reviewer-transport decision before any successor calibration.
limitations: Four Gemini canary votes are insufficient for reviewer-quality interpretation.
DeepSeek returned no usable response, token usage, or authoritative cost on the failure path.
Known USD 0.00780825 covers the Gemini canary only and is not complete run cost accounting.
No 200-case panel, T0 product, visual, private-data, 600-case, or academic 10,000-case evidence was produced.
